vectors.name: a-subhash-marker-is-not-its-containing-blocks-stay
vectors.note: SPEC.md §16 mandatory reader rule (v1.6): a tool MUST NOT report a marker carrying the exact `subhash` key as the stay of the block containing it. The key is compared exactly, without segmenting or resolving a child, so a tool that implements neither §5.5 nor §5.6 still applies it. Four readings in one document. `c1` on the list item carries a deliberately wrong `hash` beside its `subhash`, and that is NOT container drift: an unfiltered reader emits a fourth HASH_DRIFT here. `x9` carries `x-subhash`, which is an ordinary extension key and stays block-level, so its wrong hash IS drift. `cb` carries `subhash=bogus`: the filter is key presence, not value validity, so it is filtered too. The DUPLICATE_ID on `c1` proves the lexical, document-global buckets survive the filter, because that duplicate spans a child marker and a block marker.
